Unicorn’s Rainbow Route

Age 4–5 YearsClass 30 · LogicSkill Following a color key

Red, blue, yellow — hop the rainbow colors in order and lead the unicorn to the castle.

Play the puzzle game ↓Print the worksheet ↓Play with a finger, a stylus or a mouse. Instructions are spoken aloud.
PLAY · FOLLOWING A COLOR KEY

Unicorn’s Rainbow Route

Follow the key: red, then blue, then yellow. Tap the colors in that order to reach the castle!

Tap the route colors in the key’s order: red, blue, yellow.

Castle reached!

Red, blue, yellow — the unicorn prances to the castle.

FOR GROWN-UPS

Why this adventure helps.

This game trains following a color key on the puzzle picture itself: the question is spoken aloud, the answers are pictures, and a miss brings a gentle hint instead of a penalty. Ask your child to explain the rule out loud — saying the “why” is the whole skill.

Prefer paper? The Unicorn’s Rainbow Route worksheet prints the same puzzle with room to draw, sort and circle — and a grown-up answer line. Printing never marks anything complete.
